# Max Burlak

> AI-driven product designer helping B2B SaaS founders design experience, build design systems, and ship measurable outcomes.

Canonical site: https://maxburlak.com/
Contact: hey@maxburlak.com
Book a call: https://cal.com/maxburlak/oppchat
Resume (PDF): https://maxburlak.com/max-burlak-resume.pdf

## Summary

Max Burlak is a founding product designer (3×) with 13+ years in B2B SaaS. He helps founders move from idea to shipped product with focus on activation, conversion, design systems, retention, and AI-native workflows. He has contributed to outcomes including 0→$2.5M+ ARR growth and companies preparing for funding rounds totaling around $150M.

Based in Barcelona, Spain. Available for founding designer roles, product design, design systems, AI integration, and consulting.

## Expertise

- Founding / lead product design for B2B SaaS
- Activation, onboarding, and time-to-value
- Conversion, pricing, packaging, and monetization
- Design systems and delivery velocity
- Retention and expansion UX
- Stakeholder alignment under scope pressure
- AI-assisted design and expert-multiplier workflows

## Selected experience

- **Default.com** — Founding Product Designer → Design Lead (2022–2026). Revenue workflow platform; design systems and product workflows for revenue teams.
- **Apollo.io** — Senior Product Designer → Design Lead → Design System Lead (2021–2023).
- **P2P Validator**, **Commun**, **Kinescope** — prior product design roles (2018–2021).

## Portfolio highlights (on homepage)

- Default: workflow builder iterations, design systems, shipped under tight constraints
- Apollo.io: data-quality initiative scaled to dedicated product squad
- NDA crowdfunding project: 250+ screens, 4 user roles, shipped in ~6 months
